concept.literalSynthesis: A red-sparking wand stitched into a vampire's fitted coat: the coat's seams glow like veins, and each cast sends a bright ember out from its cuff.
concept.coreMechanic: Use the mantle to cast one cursor-aimed magic ember every 0.433 seconds. It travels at 26.25 blocks/s, curves downward under gravity, deals 12 magic damage, and ends on its first NPC hit or solid tile. That hit heals its owner for 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP per hit. The use costs 4 mana per native use animation. While equipped in an accessory slot, the mantle adds 2 defense, 1 HP/s life regeneration, and 5% movement speed; these bonuses do not apply merely for holding it. The ember keeps the wand's damage, mana cost, cadence, and healing fraction while using the observed single-hit policy and 1.5-second lifetime. The accessory adds explicit defense to the suit's observed life regeneration and movement bonus. Both parents have generation depth 0, but that does not establish a progression tier, so no tier is claimed.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampiric spark wand supplies the red ember identity and the magic-casting role. Its observed 12 damage, 4 mana cost, 26-tick cadence, 7-pixel-per-tick launch speed, gravity arc, and capped on-hit healing inform the mantle's active shot.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire suit supplies the wearable, sewn vampire-coat identity and the equipped-support role. Its observed +1 HP/s life regeneration and +5% movement speed become explicit accessory effects; the mantle also gains a deliberate +2 defense bonus.
concept.playerExperience: Aim with primary use to fire a single ember; the short-lived shot can restore at most 1 HP on a successful hit. Equip the mantle for modest defense, regeneration, and movement bonuses. Each new use animation attempts the 4-mana payment; equipping is passive and grants no benefit while the item is merely held.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim and cast a single gravity-curved magic ember that can return a small amount of life on hit.
Wear the stitched mantle as an accessory for defense, life regeneration, and movement speed.
On an ember's actual damaging NPC hit, heal its owner for 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP.

realization.description: Primary use fires one cursor-aimed ember for 4 mana per new use animation. The 12-damage magic projectile travels at 26.25 blocks/s, curves downward, lasts up to 1.5 seconds, and stops at its first NPC hit or solid tile. A damaging hit heals the owner for 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP. While equipped as an accessory, the mantle grants 2 defense, +1 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. Holding it alone grants no defense or accessory bonuses.
realization.playerExperience: Fire individual shots with primary use and aim them toward the cursor. The projectile's healing requires a real NPC hit and is capped per hit; misses provide no healing. Equip the item to receive its three passive bonuses.
realization.selfEvaluation: The active and equipped functions are separate bindings. The item body is the primary entity; the free ember is the single explicit active spawn target. Gravity, damage, collision, lifetime, and on-hit healing are authored on that projectile.
